messages:
Margo: Morning — quick async check. TL;DR: content calendar updated for launch week. Attached benchmark post is drafted but I need final latency numbers and high-res screenshots.

Margo: What I did: drafted hero blog, social snippets, and banner copy.
Blockers: @Samir need p99/p95 numbers + @Priya needs UI screenshots.
Today: finalize CMS schedule and merge the remaining PRs.

Samir: On it. Ran a baseline bench last night, raw report: https://internal.redwood/bench/1881 (internal link). p50: 45ms, p95: 120ms, p99: 240ms. Will run a second pass with prefix caching enabled and post numbers here.

Margo: Perfect — please paste the table when done. We want the benchmark callout to show cache impact.

Priya: I can take screenshots once Samir posts the new numbers. Which routes do we want captured? hero, compare view, latency graph?

Diego: tiny heads-up — pushed a CSS PR to tweak CTA color on the hero. @Jules can you review? PR: https://github/rdw/marketing/5678

Jules: Reviewing now. Quick look: LGTM for layout. One nit on alt text for the hero image, will leave a comment and approve after that is fixed.

Samir: Second pass complete with prefix caching. New numbers: p50 38ms, p95 95ms, p99 180ms. Table below (copy into the post):

| metric | no-cache | with-cache |
| p50 | 45ms | 38ms |
| p95 | 120ms | 95ms |
| p99 | 240ms | 180ms |

bench-bot: scheduled report uploaded to /shared/benchmarks/launch-1881.csv

Margo: Thanks! @Priya once you upload screenshots to the CDN can you drop links here? Planning to schedule the benchmark post for 10:00 PT Wed.

Priya: Uploading now. Links: https://cdn.redwood/assets/launch/hero.png https://cdn.redwood/assets/launch/latency-graph.png

Margo: Great. I'll update the CMS and queue social copy. Diego — please merge after Jules' approval so the staging build matches the screenshots.

Diego: Will merge post-approval.

Jules: Approved and left the alt text fix. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging at 2026-03-17T10:00:00Z (sha: ff12a9)

Margo: Quick ask — can someone sanity-check the copy on staging before we promote to production? Prefer a quick ✅ within the hour.

Samir: Quick perf sanity on staging looks good — no regressions observed.

Priya: Copy looks fine, fixed one small comma in the hero and re-uploaded the image.

Margo: Awesome, thanks team. I'll post the final go/no-go in #launch-ops at 15:00 PT. Closing loop for this thread.
